title: VOIDLAB
tagline: A cosmic sandbox: paint matter, bend gravity and see what happens.
stateNote: Runs in the browser. You can save and share a universe.
problem: Gravity and star formation are easier to feel than to read about. VOIDLAB lets you paint elements into empty space and watch them collapse, orbit and ignite.
audience: Anyone curious about space who likes sandboxes.
contribution: It is my project. I haven't linked a public repository for it.
worksToday: Paint elements such as hydrogen, iron and dark matter into space.
Orbit assist, pause-to-build and a field guide of 25 entries, as shown on the site.
limitations: It is a toy model, not a physics simulation.
I've checked that it loads and runs, not every feature.
